projects.title: READY.QUIT.SOLID

projects.tags: Next.js 16 · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Strapi 5 · PostgreSQL · HubSpot API · Docker
details: Main contributor on front end and CMS: built the Next.js site from Figma and designed the Strapi content models and APIs behind it

Worked directly with the client over Slack and ClickUp: requirements, UAT feedback, fixes in short cycles

projects.title: House Nine & Nine and Found
projects.summary: Rebuild for an interior design studio: portfolio site and headless Shopify store on one CMS.
projects.tags: Next.js 16 · NestJS · Prisma · PostgreSQL · Redis · Shopify
details: Built features across 3 apps: 2 public Next.js sites (studio and Shopify store) and the NestJS + React CMS shared by both
Developed the CMS admin: content editors, media library, and user and role management
Integrated the Shopify Storefront API for product listings, filters and search
Made the sites faster and sturdier: lighter images, lazy loading, fewer API calls, pages that stay up when Shopify is down
Delivered in 3 milestones agreed with the client (UI, CMS, then docs and user guides), reviewed over Slack and Google Meet

Built animated, interactive sections for the campaign content and delivered client change requests

projects.title: PushMeUp
projects.tags: React · TypeScript · MediaPipe · WebRTC · Cloudflare TURN · WebSockets · AWS · Terraform
projects.summary: A home-workout web app that counts your reps through the camera, with motion games you can play against a friend.
details: Pose tracking in the browser with MediaPipe: counts reps for push-ups, squats, planks and more, with guided workouts and a spoken coach
Motion games (Shapeshift, Hurdles, Hole in the wall, Dodge ball) played solo, two on one device, or head to head over Duo

Duo matches peer to peer over WebRTC, paired through a small WebSocket server, with Cloudflare TURN relaying video when players can't connect directly; kept smooth on phones by moving the pose model to a Web Worker
Runs on EC2 provisioned with Terraform, shipped through GitHub Actions; English and Vietnamese

projects.title: LoadForge
projects.tags: AWS · Terraform · NestJS · Next.js · k6 · GitHub Actions
projects.summary: A self-built lab for learning AWS: load-test an auto-scaling Node.js fleet, then harden it step by step.
details: Provisioned the whole stack with Terraform: VPC, HTTPS load balancer, EC2 Auto Scaling with CloudWatch alarms, keyless GitHub OIDC deploys
Three apps: the servers under test (NestJS), a watcher that streams the Auto Scaling group and CloudWatch over SSE, and a Next.js dashboard
Raised throughput by 47% (26.7 → 39.2 req/s), cut health-check latency under load from ~20 s to 8 ms and scale-out from ~3 min to 30–50 s
Every change measured with a k6 load generator, shipped through zero-downtime CI/CD

projects.title: Coding Guide
projects.tags: Claude Code · MCP · Next.js · Strapi · AWS
projects.summary: Claude Code skills distilled from lessons on client projects, used in daily work.
details: A review checklist built from the bugs that came up most often across projects, checked against every change
Bug-fix workflow automated via ClickUp MCP: fix, self-review, open pull requests and report back, with human approval at each step
One-command setup for new Next.js + Strapi projects, wired to the client's technical criteria
EC2 deploy playbooks (Docker + GHCR, and PM2) that record every mistake made on the first production run
General UI/UX rules with a review checklist for building and reviewing screens
